QuestInfo.name: Unspoken Words
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce contacted you. Maybe she's heard from one of the heroes.
QuestInfo.1: She says she wants to speak to you in person. Her hesitant tone does not fill you with confidence.
QuestInfo.2: You came to the Bowman Instructional School in Henesys to hear what Athena Pierce has to say. She didn't look well, and you predict that it won't be good news.

0.0: Shade, I should have told you this earlier... I thought about it over and over, and I don't think I can hide it from you anymore. If you're not busy, can you come see me?\r\n#r(You will be moved directly to the map if you accept.)#k

no.0: I guess I can't force you to come right now, but please do when you get the chance. This can't wait any longer.

1.0: Did you get to know Maple World a little better during your stay? You already seem much stronger. You probably tried even harder for your... friends...
